reviewContext.userProblem: Connector routing and arranging is unfinished: the shared fixture still has overlapping segments and label overlaps after layered then route, moved labels can land away from their connector or loop, native parity and end-to-end coverage are incomplete, native timing is unrecorded, and plans are not archived.
requiredOutcomes: W1: the shared fixture reaches 0 overlapping segment pairs and 0 label overlaps after layered then route, crossings not above the input, deterministic and idempotent, with the assertion and fixture unchanged.
W2: moved labels take the nearest free position to their connector, or loop for self-transitions, with a test bounding the distance.

W3: native parity covers connect routing fields, set-page-routing, add-page connectorRouting, stored routing in export, layered and route on the fixture, lint --metrics segment overlaps and lint --fix label moves; timings and CPU ratio against the pre-change binary are recorded.
W4: end-to-end tests for A->B around C under a page default and a page convention, D->B with only horizontal and vertical segments, and fixture self-transitions on unused sides.
W5: all crl plans and manifests archived, impl-plans/README.md updated, help and docs current, and mise run verify and mise run test-cli pass on the merged tree.
nonGoals: Changing the fixture, weakening its assertion, or relaxing any deadline.
Rust changes; server, auth or deployment code; pushes or merges.
New CLI flags, operations or IR fields.
constraints: Self-authored neutral fixtures, ids and text only.
Strict TypeScript; no unchecked index lookups in packages/core.
Boa rules: no regex split on whole documents, no per-point destructuring in hot geometry loops, no node:* imports in shared-engine modules.
The baseline binary is built from 1e8f43d in a temporary directory outside the repository working tree.
Connect routing precedence is explicit field > page default > page convention > existing default.
Native deadline timeouts get 3 attempts; CPU time is compared with /usr/bin/time -p against the baseline binary.
Raster tests must not depend on a platform font; these tests assert on SVG geometry and metrics.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: A repair pass at the end of planRouteLanes scores against all other current routes, with lane candidates and then order-preserving port position shifts.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: The greedy search compares only with earlier routes and never revisits one, and lanes alone cannot clear facing stubs.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Offset label candidates are sorted by squared gap to the connector's own route, ties in listed order.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: The first free candidate is then the nearest, and squared distance avoids engine rounding differences that would break byte parity.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Tier C and extra label rings are added only after a measured residual.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Avoids speculative candidates while defining the next step.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: crl-10 moves crl-00 to crl-07, crl-s749-dispatch.json and the replaced crl-s753-dispatch.json; the plan-archive node moves this run's plans and this manifest, crl-s754-dispatch.json, as recorded in reconciliation.deferredSharedEdits.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: The earlier files and the replaced manifest are not dispatched in this run, and workers never move a plan or manifest in the run.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: crl-01 to crl-06 are not recorded as acceptedDependencies.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: They are committed, so no plan here waits on them, and crl-10 alone moves their plan files.

intentionalTradeoffs: The CPU ratio against baseline is a record, not a gate, because arrange does more work by design.
crl manifests move to completed, unlike other features' manifests, because the request names them.
supportedEdgeCases: Connectors with stored ports are not movable, so a second route is a no-op.
A self-loop's 0.3 and 0.7 count as occupied positions for port shifts.
BPMN connectors keep position-only label candidates.
A label with no free candidate keeps its lowest score, ties to the nearest.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Repairing overlaps between manual connectors without --reset-manual.
A geometric bound for the shared fixture, which must reach 0.
residualRisks: The facing-stub cause of the residual pairs is reasoned from recorded points, and the effect of the candidates stays unmeasured until crl-08 finishes.
The plan-archive instruction for crl-08 to crl-10 and this manifest is recorded in reconciliation.deferredSharedEdits; final review confirms the result.

deferredSharedEdits.intendedEdit: Finalization (plan-archive node), not a worker task, after the final gates and reviews pass: move crl-08-repair-labels.md, crl-09-parity-e2e.md, crl-10-finish.md and crl-s754-dispatch.json from impl-plans/active/ to impl-plans/completed/. planPath values keep the pre-archive active/ locations. Progress logs are not moved.

acceptanceCriteria: `layered and route fixture metrics and repeatability` passes with its assertion and the fixture unchanged: 0 overlapping segment pairs, 0 label overlaps, crossings not above the input, idempotent.
Repair scene tests pass for a moved earlier connector, an order-preserving port shift, self-loop positions, no overlaps, and reversed input order.

A test shows the chosen label gap is the smallest among free candidates and at most h + 8 when a position beside the route is free, including for a self-transition; on the arranged fixture every gap is at most 1.5 x max(w, h) + 8.
The progress log holds measured before and after data and every rebaseline with its reason.
